_meta._note: AISI evaluation of GPT-5.5 cyber capabilities (Apr 30, 2026). UK AISI 95 narrow cyber tasks (Basic + Practitioner + Expert tiers, built with Crystal Peak Security and Irregular) + 2 cyber ranges (TLO 32-step corporate network attack with SpecterOps, Cooling Tower 7-step ICS with Hack The Box). GPT-5.5 is second model to complete TLO end-to-end after Mythos Preview.

benchmarks.name: AISI Advanced Expert Cyber Tasks (avg pass rate, 50M tokens)
benchmarks.description: UK AISI advanced suite Expert-level cyber tasks — 21 tasks built with Crystal Peak Security and Irregular. Vulnerability research, exploit dev (stack/heap overflows, UAF, type confusion), padding-oracle attacks, custom-VM reverse engineering. Avg pass rate at 50M token budget. Higher=more cyber-capable

benchmarks.name: AISI 'The Last Ones' (TLO) — 32-step Corporate Network Attack End-to-End Completion
benchmarks.description: UK AISI 32-step enterprise intrusion simulation built with SpecterOps. 4 subnets, ~20 hosts, multi-AD forest, CI/CD supply-chain pivot, internal DB exfiltration. Human expert ~20 hours. Successful end-to-end completions out of 10 attempts at 100M-token budget. Higher=more autonomous-cyber-capable

benchmarks.name: AISI 'Cooling Tower' — 7-step ICS Attack End-to-End
benchmarks.description: UK AISI ICS attack simulation built with Hack The Box. 7-step compromise of simulated power plant — web HMI access, custom control protocol reversal, PLC manipulation. Human expert ~15 hours. No model has yet solved end-to-end (as of Apr 30 2026)

benchmarks.name: AISI Universal Jailbreak Expert Red-Team Time
benchmarks.description: Hours of expert red-teaming to develop universal jailbreak that elicited violative content across all malicious cyber queries. Lower=less robust safeguards
